items.summary: Brand Information: Rick Owens DRKSHDW continues the dark elegance exemplified by its parent brand. Launched in 2005, Rick Owens DRKSHDW is the more accessibly-priced sub-brand of Rick Owens. The sub-brand boasts a streetwear-oriented collection of staples such as sweats, hoodies, T-shirts, shorts, pants, and of course, sneakers.
